untrusted: In an untrusted folder, the places of programs and DLLs in its settings are not used.
description: PC-E500 series BASIC and SC62015 assembly (e500asm) syntax checking, and running, debugging and testing in the PC-E500 emulator.
debugger.label: PC-E500 Emulator
launch.program: The source to run: a .asm is assembled and run as machine code, a .bas is LOADed from the CE-140F and run as BASIC.
launch.entry: The label or address to start at (&HBEC00 ...). By default START, MAIN, or the first byte.
launch.mode.basic: Type CALL at BASIC's prompt (for a routine that returns to BASIC with RETF)
launch.mode.direct: Jump there with a return address pushed (the registers are shown when it returns)
launch.return: With direct: whether the routine returns with RETF (far) or RET (near).
launch.registers: With direct: registers set before the call (e.g. {"A": 3, "X": "&HBED00"}).
launch.memory: Memory written before starting (address → an array of bytes or a string).
launch.stopOnEntry: Stop at the entry (the first line for BASIC). By default it runs on to a breakpoint.
launch.stopOnReturn: Stop when a direct routine returns.
launch.rom: ROM file (by default the setting pcE500.romPath).
launch.ram: Internal RAM in KB (by default the setting pcE500.ramKB).
launch.state: An emulator state file (*.e500state) to load instead of starting afresh.
launch.speed: Speed (1 = as the real machine, 0 = as fast as it goes). By default the setting pcE500.speed.
snippet.call.label: PC-E500: Run with BASIC's CALL
snippet.call.name: PC-E500: Run with CALL
snippet.direct.label: PC-E500: Call a routine directly
snippet.direct.name: PC-E500: Call directly
config.basic.title: BASIC
config.requireLineNumbers: Report source lines that do not start with a line number.
config.asm.title: Assembly
config.includeDirectories: Additional directories searched by INCLUDE / INCBIN (same as e500asm -I). Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder.
config.defines: Symbols defined before assembling (same as e500asm -D NAME=VALUE).
config.assemblerPath:
e500asm (`e500asm.exe` or `e500asm.cmd` on Windows), for "Assemble with e500asm". Empty: the one on PATH.

[Check the setup](command:pcE500.checkSetup)
config.e500.title: Emulator
config.emulatorPath:
Folder of the PC-E500 emulator. `e500core.dll` (also under `bin/` and `app/`) and `rom/` (`app/rom/`) are looked for there. Empty: one on PATH, or where it is installed.

[Check the setup](command:pcE500.checkSetup)
config.diskFolder: Folder of the CE-140F's X: drive, where "Make BIN" copies to. Empty: `drive-x` of `pcE500.emulatorPath`.
config.corePath: The emulator's core `e500core.dll` (one with the debugger functions). Empty: found from `pcE500.emulatorPath`.
config.romPath: ROM file (256KB or 384KB). Empty: picked from the `rom` folder of `pcE500.emulatorPath`, `PC-E500(7.2).ROM` first.
config.ramKB: Internal RAM in KB. 32 for the PC-E500 and PC-E500S, 64 for the PC-E550, PC-E650 and PC-U6000.
config.speed: Speed (1 = as the real machine, 2 = twice as fast, 0 = as fast as it goes).
config.openPanelOnDebug: Open the emulator panel when debugging starts.
config.serverPath: The debug server `e500dbg.exe`. Empty: the one in the extension (`out/server/`).
config.paths.title: Paths of the Assembler and the Emulator
